key_idea: Process each column bottom-up keeping the lowest free row, resetting it just above every obstacle.
sketch: For each column scan from the bottom row upward with a pointer to the next free cell; an obstacle sets the pointer to the row above it, an apple is moved to the pointer and the pointer decreases. O(R*C). The only pitfall is that step-by-step simulation is O(R^2*C) and too slow.
